course.title: Makeup Artistry
course.tagline: Do flawless makeup for every skin tone: skin prep, glam looks and bridal-ready finishes.

days.title: Welcome to Makeup Artistry
days.goal: By the end of today you can explain and practise: Your kit is brushes, sponges, primers, foundations, concealers, powders and setting spray.

video.title: How to Apply Makeup Step by Step: Full-Face Tutorial

steps: Get your tools ready: beauty sponge, foundation brush and eyeshadow brush.
Watch the video. It explains the main point in simple steps: A damp beauty sponge blends foundation seamlessly.
Your kit is brushes, sponges, primers, foundations, concealers, powders and setting spray. Go slowly. Practise on a model or a practice head.
Do the same move three times. Check your work in a mirror or a photo after each try.
Write down what went well, what was hard, and one thing to do better tomorrow.
days.task: Practise welcome to makeup artistry on a model or a practice head. Your kit is brushes, sponges, primers, foundations, concealers, powders and setting spray. Take a photo of your work.
days.challenge: Do welcome to makeup artistry two times today. Make the second try neater than the first.

quiz.q: What does a damp beauty sponge do to foundation?
options: A dry beauty sponge blends foundation seamlessly.
A damp beauty sponge blends foundation seamlessly.
A damp beauty sponge leaves foundation streaky.

quiz.explain: A damp beauty sponge blends foundation seamlessly.

quiz.q: Which tool blends foundation smoothly onto the skin?
options: foundation brush
eyeshadow brush
beauty sponge
setting spray
quiz.explain: A beauty sponge blends foundation smoothly onto the skin.

quiz.q: What should you never do with a mascara wand?
options: Dip the same wand back into the tube after using it.
Share one wand between two clients.
Put a used wand back in the tube for later.
never double-dip mascara wands
quiz.explain: Never double-dip mascara wands.

days.title: Hygiene and Brush Care
